title: Independently owned. One standard.
intro: Every JaniCrew is owned and run by someone local. Every JaniCrew works to the same written standard. Here is what that means for your building.

commitments.title: A written scope for every room
commitments.body: Before we start, you get a room-by-room list of exactly what we clean and how often. No guessing and no "general cleaning".

commitments.title: Insured, bonded and licensed
commitments.body: Every crew carries insurance and bonding and holds the licences your area requires. Ask to see them.

commitments.title: A local owner you can call
commitments.body: Your JaniCrew is run by someone who lives and works in your community. When you call, you reach the person responsible.

commitments.title: Uniformed, identifiable crews
commitments.body: Our people wear the JaniCrew diamond. You always know who is in your building.

commitments.title: A free walkthrough, not a sales pitch
commitments.body: Five to ten minutes on site, a monthly estimate in writing, and no obligation.

commitments.title: Built around your regulations
commitments.body: Medical, food service, schools, fitness: we tailor specifications to the rules your industry works under.
